description: All Scalarized UCB and Scalarized KG experiments: holistic and Cheetah reductionist; gravity, synchronization, request-rate heterogeneity; separate RTS and STR.
seed_note: Run r uses base_seed+(r-1)*seed_increment for fresh online trajectories, and evaluation_base_seed+(r-1)*evaluation_seed_increment for fresh held-out scenarios and Sobol designs. Seeds are paired across algorithms and sweep conditions within a run; independent runs share no simulation or evaluation cache.
execution_note: Run sequentially by independent run, algorithm, approach, experiment. Each existing script uses four held-out worker processes and resumes its own compatible checkpoint. This configuration has not been run.
configuration_note: All setup values and Xi matrices are embedded here. The batch calls existing experiment scripts with generated setup JSON files; it does not read their adjacent setups, calibration JSON, or current result files.
budget_note: 150 online requests for both algorithms. UCB initializes 49 arm-direction pairs and has 101 adaptive requests; KG initializes twice (98 requests) and has 52 adaptive requests. Held-out horizons remain 100 holistic and 50 reductionist.

UCB.implementation: RTS/STR scalarized UCB with paper Eqs. 26, 43-48; negative max-length scalarization of normalized costs, matching KG.

bandit.initialization_note: 7 arms times 7 directions = 49 initialization requests, followed by 101 adaptive UCB requests in the common 150-request online budget.
bandit.cost_reference_note: Fixed lower reference for normalized costs, strictly below zero, shared with KG. Separate from the upper total-cost hypervolume reference.

KG.implementation: Selective Pressure Allocation Section 6.3.2, Eqs. 26 and 49-52; Gaussian exploration from Yahyaa et al. (2014), Section 4.2.

bandit.initialization_note: Two full passes of 7 arms times 7 directions = 98 initialization requests, followed by 52 adaptive KG requests.
bandit.cost_reference_note: Fixed lower reference in normalized cost coordinates, strictly below nonnegative observations (Eq. 24). Distinct from the upper total-cost hypervolume reference.
bandit.kg_index: se * (phi(q) - q * Phi(-q)); q = abs(mean - minimum_other_arm_mean) / se
bandit.exploration_note: B=(T-k)*K*D*v; K=7, D=2, T=150. k is the upcoming one-based online request; the final request has zero bonus.

original_paper.title: Knowledge Gradient for Multi-objective Multi-armed Bandit Algorithms

evaluation.note: Approximate the sequence set over recommended arms with 16 common Sobol draws and all constant sequences; remove duplicates. Use two held-out scenario seeds, paired across algorithms, formulations, and sweep levels. Evaluation never updates the bandit.
evaluation.hypervolume_note: Empirical RTS/STR polar hypervolume of the sampled sequence set, using the same fixed total-cost reference as MORBO/qNParEGO. Plot current estimates, without a cumulative maximum.

comparison_note: Same cost scalarization and lower reference for UCB and KG; same arms, directions, online budgets, physical normalization bounds, held-out horizons, scenarios, and upper hypervolume references. Initialization lengths differ by algorithm. Empirical results describe these settings and do not prove a method fails generally.
